item.title: Unique little pool! Circa 1924 in Arkansas. $189,900
item.description: This house has a lot of potential! That pool is unique! The house was built in 1924. It is located in Little Rock, Arkansas. The house features a brick exterior, arched front entryway, wood floors, chair rails, crown moulding, arched french doors and a telephone nook. The backyard is spacious and fenced with an in-ground pool. There is a detached garage on the property. item.title: Beautiful stained glass!! Circa 1920. Over an acre in Arkansas. $74,900
item.description: This church has some beautiful stained glass windows! Nice doors too. The church was built in 1920. It is located on 1.49 acres in Holly Grove, Arkansas. The church features beautiful doors, stunning stained glass, chair rails, vaulted ceiling, original church pews and a spacious kitchen. There are two bathrooms and 6,000 square feet. $74,900 Contact Angela M. item.title: Wow! What a property! Has historic flume for gold mining on property! C. 1861 in California. $1,949,000
item.description: Wow! What a property! That old restored flume would have been used during the old gold mining days. This house was built in 1861. It is located on .36 acre in Nevada City, California. The main house features wood floors, coffered ceiling, a lot of tea cups, crown moulding, updated bathrooms and a screened in porch. item.title: New Mexico’s most expensive old house listing! C. 1931. On 11 acres. $15,000,000
item.description: Welcome to New Mexico’s most expensive old house listing! Love the beautiful grounds! Known as Casa Alegre. The house was built in 1931 by Governor Dempsey. It also had other prominent residents. There was an heir to the Weyerhaeuser timber fortune and a member of the Martini and Rossi family. The property has the main house, three guesthouses, heated pool and a private tennis court. Ten bedrooms, eleven bathrooms and 12,208 square feet. $15,000,000 From the Zillow listing: Experience the rare o

item.title: Mountain cottage in North Carolina. Great getaway spot! C. 1945. $149,000
item.description: What a great getaway spot this would be! Beautiful area! The cottage was built in 1945. It is located on .45 acre in Franklin, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, metal roof, some wood floors and a loft area. This is the type of house where you could move in, enjoy it and do projects as you felt like it. There is a small detached storage shed on the property. Two bedrooms and one bathroom. $149,000 Contact John Pippio with RE/MAX Elite Realty From the Zillow listing: Charmi

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! C. 1739. On 1 1/2 acres in Virginia. $149,900
item.description: Fixer Upper Alert! This has potential! The house was built in 1739. It is located on 1.5 acres in Farmville, Virginia. The house features a small covered porch, wainscoting, pretty mantel, chair rails, spacious kitchen and an english basement. The house definitely needs work. One mantel looks fairly early. There is a detached storage building and mature trees on the property. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,944 square feet. $149,900 Contact Larry D. Atkins with State Wide Realty Company: 434-

item.title: Circa 1786 in Connecticut! Love those wide floorboards! $279,000
item.description: I love the wide floorboards in this house! Great fireplaces too! The house was built in 1786. It is located on .29 acre in East Hartford, Connecticut. The house features wide floorboards, built-in bookshelves, chair rails, crown moulding, large fireplaces, spacious kitchen and a lot of natural light. There is a large detached garage on the property that has unfinished space above. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,491 square feet. $279,000 Contact Tatiana Cozar with Coldwell Banker Realty: 203

item.title: Ohio’s most expensive old house listing! Riverstone Farm on 77 acres. $4,400,000
item.description: Welcome to Ohio’s most expensive old house listing! Riverstone Farm is beautiful! It started off as a hunting lodge and summer home for wealthy industrialist, Frederic H. Chaplin. Riverstone Farm was built in 1940. It is located on 77 acres in Willoughby, Ohio. The property includes a 3/4 mile driveway, a main house, “Chapin’s Lodge”, a two story guest house, a two story studio barn and a four stall horse barn. Five bedrooms, five bathrooms and 7,600 square feet. $4,400,000 From the Zillow listi

item.title: Beautiful Ocracoke in the Outer Banks of North Carolina. C. 1883. $550,000
item.description: Ocracoke is one of the barrier islands of the Outer Banks. It is only accessible by ferry. It’s a beautiful place! This house is known as Tom Frank Gaskins House. It was built in 1883. The house is located in Ocracoke, North Carolina. The house features a cedar shake shingle exterior, a screened in porch, tongue and groove walls, wood floors, great kitchen sink and a claw foot tub. It’s nice that the house has already been raised.
